art_instructions: Inside the bright, cozy classroom, place a low honey-oak table across the center of the frame with Koala standing at the table slightly left of center. Koala is small and round, with soft gray fur, big fluffy ears, a charcoal nose, a faint heart-shaped light patch on her chest, and she wears her leaf-green scarf; her tiny acorn-brown backpack hangs on the back of a nearby child-sized chair. She holds one small, cartoon-gray mouse gently in both paws near her mouth, showing a tiny comedic nibble (no blood or gore), and she grimaces with eyes squinting and tongue slightly out to show it tastes bad. A speech bubble next to her mouth reads «οὐ!» in clear, large Koine letters. On the right side of the same tabletop, show the other two mice still on the table beside an open picture book with simple large Greek letters, linking back to reading time. Keep the background consistent with the school interior: soft blue walls, a sunlit large window casting bright natural light, a colorful geometric woven rug on the stone floor, and a glimpse of a small teacher’s podium with blue-and-white pottery; no other animals are visible. The mood is humorous and gentle, with clean, simple shapes appropriate for very young readers.
